title_i18n.zh: 谷歌称首次发现利用AI开发“零日漏洞”攻击工具

excerpt_i18n.en: On the 11th, Google's Threat Intelligence Group released a report stating that it had, for the first time, discovered cyber attackers using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to develop a "zero-day vulnerability" attack tool. In the report, Google's Threat Intelligence Group noted that this "zero-day vulnerability" attack tool targets a "popular open-source, web-based system management tool," is implemented using Python scripts, and can bypass two-factor authentication. Google stated that it has notified the affected company of the vulnerability and blocked the related threat activities. (Xinhua News Agency)

Las vulnerabilidades de día cero son fallos de seguridad que los fabricantes de software aún no han descubierto o no tienen tiempo de reparar. En el informe, el grupo de inteligencia de amenazas de Google indicó que esta herramienta de ataque de día cero está dirigida a una "herramienta popular de gestión de sistemas basada en web y de código abierto", se implementa mediante scripts de Python y puede eludir la autenticación de doble factor. items.title: 何恺明团队论文全景扫描：一场关于「生成范式」的多角度突破 | CVPR 2026
items.raw_excerpt: 2025 年到 2026 年，如果要问生成式 AI 领域最值得关注的研究方向，流匹配（Flow Matching） 是一个无法绕开的答案。 从去年起，这个名字开始频繁出现在顶会论文里、被工业界反复讨论、被拿来和统治了图像生成领域长达五年的扩散模型正面比较。 所谓流匹配，本质上是用常微分方程路径（ODE path）替代扩散模型的随机微分方程路径，让数据从噪声到图像的转变不再依赖数百步迭代，从而在理论上实现更高效的生成。但从理论可行到工程落地，中间隔着无数技术细节——训练目标怎么设计、架构怎么选、速度和质量如何兼顾，每一步都是坑。 何恺明团队正是在这个节点上，密集地交出了一份多角度的答卷。 AI科技评论总结了何恺明团队近期在CVPR大会上发表上的论文：  2025 年 5 月，他们提出了均值流（MeanFlow），首次将"均值速度场"引入生成建模；同年年底，BiFlow 在归一化流框架上实现了 700 倍加速，将 FID 推到 2.39；几乎同一时间，Improved MeanFlow（iMF）则以三个系统性修复将单步 FID 降至 1.72，首次在无蒸馏条件下超越所有蒸馏方法。 生成模型之外，团队在视觉推理（VARC，CVPR 2026）和自监督学习（Pixo，CVPR 2026）上也同时出击，共同勾勒出一个清晰的战略意图：扩散模型并不是图像生成的终点，流匹配这条路，值得全力押注。 这五篇论文之间没有直接的方法传承，方向各有侧重，但贯穿其中的核心问题始终如一： 在每一个被默认的技术选择背后，到底藏着多少被低估的优化空间？ 让"去噪"模型真正做一次去噪 理解 JiT 的工作，需要从扩散模型一个被忽视已久的痛点说起。 当前的扩散模型在训练时，网络学习预测的目标是噪声 ε 或速度 v，而非干净图像 x。 这个细节在大多数论文里被一笔

excerpt_i18n.en: From 2025 to 2026, if asked which research direction in generative AI deserves the most attention, Flow Matching is an unavoidable answer. Since last year, this name has frequently appeared in top conference papers, been repeatedly discussed in the industry, and directly compared with diffusion models that dominated image generation for five years. Flow Matching essentially replaces the stochastic differential equation path of diffusion models with an ordinary differential equation (ODE) path, enabling the transition from noise to images without relying on hundreds of iterative steps, thus theoretically achieving more efficient generation. However, from theoretical feasibility to engineering implementation, countless technical details lie in between—how to design the training objective, how to choose the architecture, and how to balance speed and quality, each step fraught with challenges. It is at this juncture that He Kaiming’s team has intensively delivered a multi-faceted response. AI Tech Review summarized the papers published by He Kaiming’s team at recent CVPR conferences: In May 2025, they proposed MeanFlow, introducing the "mean velocity field" to generative modeling for the first time; later that year, BiFlow achieved a 700x acceleration within the normalizing flow framework, pushing FID to 2.39; almost simultaneously, Improved MeanFlow (iMF) reduced single-step FID to 1.72 through three systematic fixes, marking the first time without distillation.
excerpt_i18n.es: De 2025 a 2026, si hablamos de las direcciones de investigación más destacadas en el campo de la IA generativa, el Flow Matching es una respuesta inevitable. Desde el año pasado, este nombre ha comenzado a aparecer con frecuencia en artículos de conferencias de primer nivel, ha sido debatido repetidamente en la industria y se ha comparado directamente con los modelos de difusión que han dominado el campo de la generación de imágenes durante cinco años. El llamado Flow Matching, en esencia, reemplaza la ruta de ecuaciones diferenciales estocásticas de los modelos de difusión con una ruta de ecuaciones diferenciales ordinarias (ODE path), permitiendo que la transformación de datos de ruido a imágenes ya no dependa de cientos de iteraciones, logrando así una generación teóricamente más eficiente. Sin embargo, desde la viabilidad teórica hasta la implementación práctica...

items.title: 腾讯 AI · 五问丨混元的三年战争
items.raw_excerpt: 2025年，从阿里巴巴离职的语音专家鄢志杰，正面临一个重要抉择。 鄢志杰 一边是急于在AI领域大展拳脚的京东，其研究院正招兵买马，尤其从阿里、商汤、百度等企业招揽英才；另一边是腾讯的AI Lab团队，俞栋团队也正在寻找一位值得信赖的语音领域顶尖人才。 当时，早就有意亲自管理京东研究院的刘强东求贤若渴，甚至直接与鄢志杰会面，希望将这位通义实验室语音团队的前负责人招入麾下，最终却被鄢志杰婉拒。 鄢志杰婉拒老刘的原因，并非腾讯AI Lab给出的待遇优厚——在他心中，俞栋是自己在微软时期的同事，这份情谊重逾千钧。 俞栋 于是，鄢志杰义无反顾地加入了俞栋的团队。 天有不测风云， 鄢志杰到岗时，俞栋麾下语音团队已经开始跟混元团队合作，共同开发对标豆包语音的项目——“混元-O”，此时混元团队研发任务紧张，语音+视觉理解的团队已成建制，项目已经在跑起来了。 人员调动，刚入职腾讯的鄢志杰也受到了影响。一说鄢志杰本人被调到混元，无法和俞栋“双剑合璧”；一说鄢志杰的团队被调走了一批人，而把鄢和一个三五个人的小团队留在了 AI Lab。 然而，“混元-O”项目的开发却并不顺利。由于缺乏语音数据，团队巧妇难为无米之炊，最终的训练结果自然不及预期。 这也在一定程度上导致了鄢志杰入职仅3个月便离开腾讯，转而加入京东研究院。 再之后，俞栋也在各种组织变动之下离职。俞栋走后，AI Lab 的三剑客正式全部离开了腾讯，这也为后来AI Lab的撤销埋下了伏笔。 不难发现，AI 大模型的出现，直接地挑战着互联网大厂的组织架构。 当 Transformer 架构一统语言、视觉、声音等能力，当大量算力不得不向尖端部门集中，当技术的迭代开始以周为单位计算…… 面临历史的浪潮，腾讯该何去何从？ （腾讯的 AI Lab 往事，雷峰网仍在持续跟进中，欢迎添加作者微信：william_dong，交流爆料。) 01 张正友时代：

excerpt_i18n.en: In 2025, Yan Zhijie, a speech expert who left Alibaba, faced a critical decision. On one hand, JD.com, eager to make strides in AI, was aggressively recruiting talent, especially from Alibaba, SenseTime, and Baidu. On the other hand, Tencent's AI Lab team, led by Yu Dong, was seeking a trusted top-tier speech expert. At the time, Liu Qiangdong, who had long intended to personally manage JD.com's research institute, was desperate for talent. He even met directly with Yan Zhijie, hoping to recruit the former head of Tongyi Lab's speech team, but was ultimately turned down. Yan Zhijie declined Liu not because of the generous offer from Tencent AI Lab—in his heart, Yu Dong was a former colleague from Microsoft, and this bond outweighed everything. So, Yan Zhijie unreservedly joined Yu Dong's team. However, unforeseen circumstances arose. By the time Yan Zhijie started, Yu Dong's speech team had already begun collaborating with the Hunyuan team to develop a project rivaling Doubao's speech capabilities—"Hunyuan-O." At that point, the Hunyuan team was under intense development pressure, and the speech + visual understanding team was already established, with the project underway. Personnel reshuffling affected Yan Zhijie, who had just joined Tencent. One account says Yan himself was reassigned to Hunyuan, preventing him from joining forces with Yu Dong; another says part of Yan's team was transferred, leaving him with a small group of three to five people in AI Lab. However, the development of "Hunyuan-O" did not go smoothly. Due to a lack of speech data, the team found it challenging to make progress.
